body:
**[comments] Rule 1, the name carries it: cut**

Cover the comment: the signature const bf16& at(size_t token, size_t dim) const, the two TRON_ASSERT_LT lines and the one-expression return say "bounds-checked read of (token, dim)". The no-element-write rule is a property of the type and already sits in the struct comment at lines 127-133.

Proposed: cut the comment.
